fact: Street numbering in N'Djamena began in 1990 in the first five arrondissements and was officialised in 2016, but the administrative addressing system remains incomplete, leaves out the old quarters, and is used to locate water and electricity subscribers.
title: De l'adressage officiel aux repères populaires : quels enjeux pour l'orientation spatiale dans la ville de N'Djamena ?
